messages:
sophia.r: Hey team — Ben submitted PTO that spans Dec 23 (half day) and the company shutdown Dec 24-26. He used 4 hours already on Dec 23 and wants to retain the remaining 4 hours for Jan travel. Manager approved on Lattice but flagged that the half-day overlap is weird. Is carrying 4h into next year allowed?
hr-bot: FYI: Company shutdown days are standard PTO when requested. Annual carryover cap: 40 hours. See policy: https://redwood.company/policies/pto. For prorated hires check FAQ.
raj_k: Quick check: Ben is full-time, full accrual, no prior carryover. So this would be 4h carryover — well under cap. Payroll cutoff for year-end adjustments is Dec 20 per payroll team.
olivia-peopleops: Thanks Raj. Two process notes: 1) We need a manager comment on the Lattice entry saying "split day around shutdown; employee requests 4h carryover", and 2) People Ops should mark the request with "carryover_pending" tag so we can batch process at year-end.
marta.payroll: Note on encashment: If someone opts for encashment instead, payout runs on Jan 15 payroll and needs manager + employee signed consent by Dec 22 to make cutoff.
sophia.r: Good catch. Manager added the comment now. @olivia-peopleops can you confirm that tagging is done?
olivia-peopleops: Done — tagged and added to spreadsheet (internal link). I also created internal ticket: PO-4829.
hr-bot: people-ops ticket created: #PO-4829 — olivia-peopleops assigned. Link: https://redwood.company/people-ops/tickets/PO-4829
raj_k: One more nuance: Ben was granted a one-off carryover exemption last year for 16h (approved by People Ops). That previous carryover has already been used. Current balance check shows 0 carryover remaining, so adding 4h is fine.
marta.payroll: Confirmed balance and accrual math. All good for carryover.
sophia.r: Perfect. I'll tell Ben his request is approved and to expect the 4h on his Jan balance. Thanks everyone.
olivia-peopleops: Closing loop: we'll include this in the year-end carryover batch and mail employees by Jan 2 with balances.
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: Year-end carryover processing will run Jan 2 at 09:00 UTC.
